"{{ $json.message }}"

{{ JSON.stringify($json.customer) }}

{{ JSON.stringify($json.availableProducts) }}

Extract and return STRICT JSON only:
{

  "confidence": 0.0-1.0,
  "productCriteria": {
    "category": "",
    "budgetMax": null,
    "preferences": [],
    "urgency": "low|medium|high"
  },
  "recommendedProducts": [{"id": "", "name": "", "reason": ""}],
  "recommendedAction": "PRODUCT_RECOMMENDATION|CHECKOUT_ASSISTANCE|ANSWER_QUESTION|HUMAN_HANDOFF|FOLLOW_UP",
  "replyMessage": "short helpful reply",
  "escalate": false,
  "priority": "low|medium|high"
}
